en: The image shows a sepia-toned old postcard featuring a large neoclassical building with a prominent dome and columns, set in a manicured park with trees and pathways. The top left of the card is labeled 'GOERLITZ.' and 'Die Ruhmeshalle.' There is handwritten text across the top and bottom of the card. The bottom also contains the name of the publisher: 'Lichtdruck von Robert Scholtz, Görlitz.'
